stop_logic.stop_poll_order_relative_to_data_network: independent parallel dataflow; no first/last ordering edge

configured_wait_budget.formula: 100 + 4*1000, excluding TCP Close, queue management, conversion, and OS/LabVIEW scheduling

main_required_lifecycle: Prior worker and producers must have finished; fixed named queues are not RunStamp-scoped.
Begin once per main run; share that exact RunStamp with camera and NI6602 observation.
Before starting workers/producers, obtain correctly typed owner refs for both named queues, capacity1; flush BOTH queues. Retain owner refs across entire run.
Start transport and producer branches in parallel, after ordered initialization. Worker has no connector inputs, so use native structure/dataflow to gate launch.
Insert FrameTap inline before downstream mutable NI image writers: image input6/output4, original-error input5/output3. Preserve one common RunStamp.
Wait for ALL producer branches/copy attempts to finish; call End with same RunStamp. End does not flush the transport queue or stop the worker.
For discard-pending shutdown, flush raw-data queue after producer completion. Flush stop queue, then enqueue Boolean True with timeout0 and check private enqueue error.

Await actual worker return before deterministic owner-ref release; do not force-destroy active queues. A finite caller wait for a separate completion acknowledgement can report timeout, but cannot cancel or hard-bound a static blocking worker call.
Only after worker return release owner refs (force destroy False). A nonforced owner release alone does not invalidate remaining worker-owned refs.
Do not begin a new run on the same names while an old worker or old in-flight transaction remains.
hazards_requiring_main_or_native_runtime: Stale True stop token can immediately terminate a newly started worker; stale Variant frame can be sent under a new main run unless initialization flush is ordered.

Owner refs prevent per-frame Obtain/Release helpers from creating and destroying their last queue ref before the worker has started. Existing queue capacity/type is not reset by Obtain; caller must establish correct ownership.
End only invalidates Epoch; queued/in-flight payloads and stop tokens are not RunStamp-scoped. Receiver acceptance is not validated by transport ACK handling.
A premature force destroy invalidates refs; data-Dequeue errors do not drive stop and there is no backoff, so repeated immediate errors can spin or invoke automatic error handling.
Unwired private error outputs with automatic error handling enabled prevent an unattended bounded-shutdown claim. Idle Variant conversion is outside the guarded network Case.
No hard worker-join deadline follows from the four1000ms constants; TCP Close/runtime scheduling and automatic error handling are outside that numeric budget.
